name: Flohmaxx Stadthafen
facts: free parking on and beside the site
pitches are handed out from 06:00 without registration, first come first served
private and commercial second-hand goods, antiques and new goods are all allowed
food and drink stand on site
notes: The organiser says only "regelmäßig" and publishes two dates in this window, 27 September and 25 October; nothing after that, so November to January are empty. Flohmaxx runs three other sites in Schwerin — Bertha-Klingberg-Platz, Sieben-Seen-Center and Pampow XXXLutz — which are separate markets, not this one. Facts and hours are from the organiser's own date page for 27 September; the location page carries the address.

description.de: Sonntags von 10 bis 16 Uhr am Stadthafen, mitten in Schwerin. Eintritt und Parken sind frei, und der Markt findet bei jedem Wetter statt. Verkaufen kann jeder: Plätze werden ab 6 Uhr ohne Anmeldung vergeben, wer zuerst da ist, steht vorn.
description.en: Sundays from 10 to 4 at the Stadthafen, in the middle of Schwerin. Entry and parking are free, and the market runs whatever the weather. Anyone can sell: pitches are handed out from 6 with no registration, first come first served.
